releases.release_notes: Workspaces, window tiling, Rouge approval cards, and working Restart / Power Off.
releases.notes: Operator Console phase 2, part 2. Workspaces: Operations / Build / Personal — switch from the top bar, the rail dots, or Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3 (Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right cycles). Each workspace keeps its own windows; opening an app that lives elsewhere brings it here. Tiling: Ctrl+Alt+T or the tile button arranges this workspace's windows (1 full, 2 side by side, 3 = main + two stacked, more = grid). Approvals: when Rouge asks to run a command, an 'Approval needed' card appears in Rouge's chat with Approve once / Deny, a gold count on the Rouge rail button and a toast. Approve still runs only through the governed, allowlisted terminal. Backend adds POST /api/terminal/reject. Power: Restart and Power Off in the MEOS menu now really work (POST /api/system/restart|poweroff via logind; one-time polkit setup with meos-power-setup) and show a shutdown screen. Crash records: a machine that was switched off (UTM Stop) is now recorded as power-loss, not a Rouge crash; a refused start (port in use) no longer leaves a false crash behind.
